channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Trump: 'If Iran retaliates, it will be struck even harder'
item.description: US President comments on US strikes in Iran, warns Iran not to further escalate the conflict.

item.title: Poll: 72.5% of Israelis reject cuts to Jewish studies in state schools
item.description: A Tzohar poll finds 72.5% of Israelis prefer to maintain the current level of Jewish, traditional and heritage studies or expand them, compared with just 18.1% who favor reducing them.

item.title: US Embassry issues warning after Iran strikes
item.description: The US Embassy in Israel has warned citizens of the "possibility of unforeseen escalation" after the US strikes on Iran Tuesday.

item.title: Initial report: US launches strikes in Iran
item.description: Initial report: US launches strikes in Iran

item.title: Head of Hamas Internal Security arrested in Gaza
item.description: ISA special forces entered a structure in the Gaza City area and apprehended the head of Hamas’ Internal Security in the Gaza Strip.

item.title: CNN commentator Scott Jennings honored for staunch support of Israel and Jewish people
item.description: CNN commentator Scott Jennings honored for staunch support of Israel and Jewish people

item.title: Elections in Brazil on Jewish holiday; thousands demand extending voting hours
item.description: Brazil’s elections will fall on Simchat Torah this year, with polls set to close at 5 pm, before the holiday ends. A petition signed by thousands seeks to extend voting until 8 pm near Jewish communities.

item.title: Merger moves forward: Smotrich and Feiglin to sign agreement tonight
item.description: Merger moves forward: Smotrich and Feiglin to sign agreement tonight

item.title: Holocaust survivor: 'Never let hatred define you; be proud of who you are'
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of Jewish students to receive personal letter and video message from Nate Leipciger, a 98-year-old Holocaust survivor, as they return to campus for the new academic year

item.title: Yair Golan to Sara Netanyahu: Apologize or face massive lawsuit
item.description: Yair Golan to Sara Netanyahu: Apologize or face massive lawsuit

item.title: For third consecutive time: Interest rate cut
item.description: The interest rate will now stand at 3.25%, and as a result, the prime rate, on which most loans and mortgages in the economy are based, will fall to 4.75%.

item.title: Anti-Israel protesters disrupt wounded IDF veterans’ campus tour in California
item.description: Despite an aggressive anti-Israel protest at their first US campus event, wounded IDF veterans Eliyahu Green and Ariel Saat vowed to continue sharing their stories of October 7, combat and recovery with students across the US.

item.title: Unaddressed violence in Judea and Samaria
item.description: They fled into their "sanctuary city", confident that no one would bother to search for them and not one of the local residents would turn them in. Op-ed.

item.title: 12 prison service personnel charged in death of security prisoner
item.description: The State Attorney’s Office has filed an indictment against 12 Israel Prison Service personnel. According to the indictment, they assaulted prisoners at Ketziot Prison, and one of them died from the beating.

item.title: Mysterious contamination disrupts Israel’s desalination plants: ‘A strange event’
item.description: Prof. Bar-Zeev, a water desalination expert, leads intensive efforts to identify the source of naturally occurring contamination threatening Israel's desalination plants.

item.title: IDF strikes Hamas commander in northern Gaza to remove threat
item.description: The eliminated terrorist had advanced attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to rehabilitate the capabilities of Hamas.

item.title: Israel Railways demands Better Rail app shut down
item.description: Israel Railways accuses the popular open-source app of unauthorized access to its systems and contributing to service disruptions.

item.title: Two years later: Police honor three officers murdered on their way to duty
item.description: Judea and Samaria District officers pause at the exact time of the 2024 shooting attack to remember three colleagues murdered on their way to duty.

item.title: Rio Jewish school sees enrollment surge after parents buy it
item.description: The Chai School in Rio de Janeiro has grown from 163 to 210 students in six months after parents took over the struggling institution with support from the Yael Foundation.

item.title: Baby food poisoning suspect pleads mental disorder
item.description: A Jerusalem court extended the detention of a Southern resident suspected of deliberately introducing sedatives into baby food purées after three infants were hospitalized.

item.title: Chief Rabbinate Council Member seeks Rabbinate intervention in Givati APC case
item.description: Rabbi Eliezer Weisz urges the Chief Rabbinate to intervene after Givati soldiers were punished for refusing to ride in an APC with a female paramedic.

item.title: Defense Minister Katz confirms: A short time ago, we arrested a senior Hamas terrorist
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz visited Netiv Ha’asara and announced that a senior Hamas terrorist had been arrested shortly beforehand. Katz said that Israel would continue pursuing and eliminating Hamas terrorists and destroying the terrorist infrastructure in the Gaza Strip.

item.title: Tali Dee Weds, carrying her mother and sisters’ memories with her
item.description: Tali Dee marries Ariel Rosenfeld in her murdered mother Lucy’s wedding dress, with touching tributes to her sisters Maia and Rina under the chuppah.

item.title: Back to school: Netanyahu joins first graders for arts and crafts
item.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu opens the new school year in Ramle, greeting first graders before joining students for a colorful arts and crafts activity.

item.title: IDF on incident in Gaza City: 'Several targets struck to remove threats'
item.description: The IDF stated that a short while ago, it struck several targets in the Gaza Strip in order to remove threats to the security forces. No IDF injuries were reported.

item.title: Mystery forces reportedly infiltrate Gaza City, heavy gun battles erupt
item.description: Witnesses report heavy gunfire and airstrikes after covert forces allegedly entered western Gaza City and encountered an ambush near the American Hospital.

item.title: ‘Regards from the terrorists’: Message to Huckabee at torched mosque
item.description: Suspected Jewish rioters torch a mosque in Samaria and leave threatening graffiti targeting journalist Roy Sharon and US Ambassador Mike Huckabee.

item.title: Tali Gotliv’s political future hangs in the balance
item.description: Talks over a possible move from Likud to Itamar Ben-Gvir’s party are advancing, as Gotliv accuses Likud officials of sidelining her.

item.title: Special delivery: Police catch alleged courier robbers ‘red-handed’
item.description: Three suspects are charged with using fake delivery orders to lure couriers into ambushes in Lod and Ramla, allegedly stealing tens of thousands of shekels.

item.title: When confronted with progressive antisemitism, Jewish liberals blame Trump
item.description: Many Jewish democrat liberals would probably only feel rain if spat upon by antisemitic progressives. Opinion.
